description: Land Acquisition - Thalawakele, Nuwara-Eliya D/S Division, Nuwara-Eliya District and two amendments to the Gaz. Ex. Nos. 1996/07 of Welikamum South-West D/S Division and 1998/8 of Gangaihala Korale D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including specific notices about government acquisition of land parcels with detailed descriptions of properties, claimants, and extents. It contains multiple notices under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act regarding land acquisition procedures, compensation inquiries, and amendments to previous acquisition notices - all falling squarely within land and property-related matters.
